description: Creates the live call booking on Cal.com. CRITICAL: pass `time` as {{selected_time}} VERBATIM (bare local time in the prospect's zone — never recompute, never a UTC `iso`). Send `timezone` as {{prospect_timezone}} in IANA format. ALWAYS use email = jaydiallux@gmail.com (system shared attendee); name falls back to {{company_name}} when no name was provided; phoneNumber already E.164.

name: create_livecall_booking

description: Records the booking confirmation id. Call right after create_livecall_booking succeeds, passing booking_uid exactly as its result returned it (a 22-character code). The server verifies it against the calendar and records it itself - if it answers invalid_uid or uid_not_found, pass the uid again exactly as shown, up to three times; then treat it as calendar trouble. Never invent, shorten, or retype the uid.
name: record_booking_uid

booking_uid.description: The booking_uid from create_livecall_booking's result, copied verbatim.
